kara-because.mnemonic_text: Jin the giant arrives an hour late to dinner, lifts a foot and points at the small car stuck to his sock: "<reading>Car, ah</reading>." That is his whole <grammar>because</grammar>. 寒い<reading>から</reading>、家に帰る。

teoku.mnemonic_text: Every autumn day, Chuu the mouse sets one acorn down inside the same hollow <reading>oak</reading>. By the first snow the tree is more acorn than wood, and winter dinner is done <grammar>in advance</grammar>. 明日の弁当を作っ<reading>ておく</reading>。

wa-topic.mnemonic_text: Toto the turtle props one sample door against your wall and asks "<reading>Wa</reading>nna talk about doors?" For the next hour, doors are <grammar>the topic</grammar>. 今日<reading>は</reading>寒い。

wo.mnemonic_text: Kaa the crow breathes one puff of flame at a single rice ball on Koichi's shelf. Koichi yells "<reading>Whoa!</reading>": that rice ball is <grammar>the thing the action hits</grammar>. ご飯<reading>を</reading>食べる。

ga.mnemonic_text: At Grandma Kane's shrine the enormous bell rings by itself. Chuu the mouse peeks inside, squeaks "<reading>Gah!</reading> A cat!" and points at <grammar>who is actually doing it</grammar>. 猫<reading>が</reading>いる。

desu.mnemonic_text: The Mon-Bun rabbit twins argue over a desk in the library. One climbs on top, stamps both feet and shouts "<reading>Des</reading>k! It <grammar>is</grammar> a desk!" これは本<reading>です</reading>。

masu.mnemonic_text: Chuu, the loyal mouse, bows until his topknot taps the floor and adds "<reading>Mas</reading>ter" to the end of every verb, giving each one a <grammar>polite ending</grammar>. お茶を飲み<reading>ます</reading>。

mashou.mnemonic_text: At the foot of the mountain trail, Grandma Kane ties her sled to six shrine cats and yells "<reading>Mush, oh!</reading>", which means <grammar>let's go</grammar>, all of us, up to the vending machine. 一緒に行き<reading>ましょう</reading>。

te-iru.mnemonic_text: Rain hits the power line, but Kaa's mother caws "<reading>Stay here</reading>!", so Kaa stays, still puffing hiss after hiss, his flame <grammar>going on right now</grammar>. 雨が降っ<reading>ている</reading>。

tai.mnemonic_text: Jin the giant squashes his nose flat on the Thai restaurant window and fogs the glass, groaning "<reading>Thai</reading>... Thai...". Every inch of him <grammar>wants to</grammar> eat. 魚を食べ<reading>たい</reading>。
